en:
If you earn coins at the casino, you can
exchange them for prizes!

You can also get Date Tickets by
earning coins here, too!
You can buy casino coins from me!
It'll cost ya a bunch of Monocoins, though!

If you don't know which prize to get with your
coins, I recommend the Monomergen-C!

It'll give you one additional block of
Free Time to use during the day!

I thought I had 1000 coins, but now I'm down
to zero...!

I'll just have to sell Monodam at a pawn
shop...!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>If you leave you can't come play again.
Would you like to leave the casino?

<CLT=cltMIND>This is OUTLAW RUN,
a driving game.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Pick up the targets with style
and try to get the high score!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Try to get multiples, combos are stylin'!
Monodam tallies and Monokid will speed up!
This has nothing to do with driving at all.
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to play the game?

<CLT=cltMIND>TREASURE HUNTERS!
It's a game where you look for treasure...

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Connect two or more of the same color!
Uncover the hidden salmon fossils!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Try to find the rare Monokub statues!
Dig them up whenever you see one!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to play the game?

<CLT=cltMIND>EXTREME FISHING!
It's a game where you fish for salmon.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>On this night, the salmon come left and right.
Use your Monokuma Eye to find them.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Fish for the color Monokuma desires.
Beware, mines hide beneath the current.
That was quite the poetic explanation...
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to play the game?

<CLT=cltMIND>MonoMono Slot...
It looks like a slot machine game.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>MonoMono Slot
How to Win at Slots

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Insert as many coins as you'd like.
Then, spin the slots!

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You have a 100% chance of winning if you
never stop! Spin spin spin forever!
<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Would you like to play the game?
